description: The figure is a multi-level (sunburst-style) pie chart summarizing the distribution of medical-ethics topics, with an inner ring showing four main principles and an outer ring listing specific subtopics under each principle; the inner ring contains 4 slices: Beneficence (blue, the largest slice at roughly about half of the circle), Autonomy (green, about a quarter), Non-Maleficence (purple, about a sixth), and Justice (orange, the smallest at about a tenth). The outer ring shows 26 labeled subtopic slices in total, grouped by the inner categories and colored to match them: under Beneficence (blue) there are 11 slices—“Open Discussion and Fair Charging of Fees,” “Ethical research,” “Minimizing Conflicts of Interest,” “Give top priority to Patient’s Interest in Conflict of Interests,” “Respect Life, Dignity of Patients,” “Respect and Cooperate with Colleagues,” “Provide Assistance in Emergency,” “Continual Learning,” “Provide Medical Care to Patients,” “Comply with Laws and Regulations,” and “Recognize the Responsibility of the Occupation”—each appearing as similarly sized narrow segments; under Autonomy (green) there are 8 slices—“Incompetent/Competent Patient,” “Decision-making of Incompetent/Competent Patient,” “Respect Patient’s Rights to be Informed, Freedom of Choice,” “Maintain Truthful, Factual Communication,” “Keep Confidential of Patient’s Information,” “Professional Relationship with Patients and Relatives,” “Make Responsible and Independent Clinical Judgement,” and “Physician Can Freely Choose Whom to Serve”—also shown as comparable-sized segments; under Non-Maleficence (purple) there are 4 slices—“Do Not Use Medicine for Personal Gain,” “Report Unethical and Unprofessional Conduct,” “Maintain Qualified When Providing Medical Care,” and “Prevent Patient from Harm”; under Justice (orange) there are 3 slices—“Treat Patients Fairly and Equally,” “Allocate Medical Sources Fairly,” and “Promote Environmental Sustainability.” There is no separate legend; labels are written directly on the slices, no numeric percentage annotations are shown, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized, with segments arranged contiguously by their parent category around the circle.
